Subject A. L. Pecker, applicant to join S.M.P. (Specials)
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by [Signature]

（正文内容）：
Alexander Leonidovich Pecker, alias Alexander
Grigorievich Pecker, alias A.L. Becker, Russian of Jewish
origin, was born on March 28, 1904 in Crimea. His late
father was a minor military functionery who after his
retirement owned a house in Harbin. Pecker received his
education in Harbin Normal Schools. In 1922 he arrived in
Shanghai and, it is said obtained employment as a sailor on
board a German ship. He worked in this capacity on various
ships until 1925 when he returned to Harbin. In Harbin he
is reported to have been employed as a book-keeper and clerk
with Leibovich Co., and later with Far Eastern Lumber Co.
In 1928 Pecker re-appeared in Shanghai and soon afterwards
joined as a luggage porter the Shanghai Express Delivery
Service, 24 Chaoufoong Road owned by L. Imas a Russian Jew.
He left this employment owing to some disaccord with the
proprietor who was not satisfied with Pecker's work. Later
for a period Pecker worked in a similar capacity with the
American Transfer Company, No.347 Broadway owned by Jack
Polonetsky, Russian Jew. During this period Pecker was
known under the name of Becker and used to reside at 23
Kungping Road with Carl Gunther, German, known criminal,
who was sentenced to ten months' imprisonment in April, 1928
in connection with an illegal arms deal. Pecker is reported
to have assisted this individual in small deals in arms
(Vide File D.19 dated 31. 139).
Subsequently, Pecker was employed by the China
Travel Service, 420 Szechuen Road as a porter. In 1934
the local office of the Chinese Maritime Customs withdrew
Pecker's pass to the jetty as a result of a complaint of a

（正文内容）：
亚历山大·列昂尼多维奇·佩克（Alexander Leonidovich Pecker），又名亚历山大·格里戈里耶维奇·佩克（Alexander Grigorievich Pecker），又名 A.L. 贝克尔（A.L. Becker），犹太裔俄国人，1904年3月28日出生于克里米亚。其已故父亲是一名低级军事官员，退休后在哈尔滨拥有一处房产。佩克在哈尔滨师范学校接受教育。1922年他抵达上海，据称在一艘德国船只上受雇为水手。他以这一身份在各种船只上工作，直到1925年返回哈尔滨。据报道，他在哈尔滨曾受雇于莱博维奇公司（Leibovich Co.）担任簿记员和职员，后来又在远东木材公司（Far Eastern Lumber Co.）任职。1928年，佩克再次出现在上海，并很快加入了位于乍浦路24号、由俄籍犹太人 L. 伊马斯（L. Imas）所有的上海快递服务公司（Shanghai Express Delivery Service），担任行李搬运工。由于与雇主发生分歧，且雇主对佩克的工作不满意，他离开了这份工作。此后一段时间，佩克在百老汇路347号、由俄籍犹太人杰克·波洛内茨基（Jack Polonetsky）所有的美国转运公司（American Transfer Company）以类似身份工作。在此期间，佩克以贝克尔（Becker）之名为人所知，并与德国人卡尔·冈瑟（Carl Gunther）同住于公平路23号；冈瑟是已知罪犯，曾因非法武器交易于1928年4月被判处十个月监禁。据报道，佩克曾协助此人进行小型武器交易（参见档案 D.19，日期为31. 139 [原文如此]）。
随后，佩克受雇于四川路420号的中国旅行社（China Travel Service），担任搬运工。1934年，中国海关当地办事处因一名乘客投诉佩克在行李搬运费上多收费用，而撤销了佩克进入码头的通行证。

据称，他在青岛期间，涉嫌在克瓦查泽（Kvachadze）的寄宿公寓内从一名俄国妇女那里盗窃了一枚钻戒。为此，他曾多次受到青岛警方的讯问。不久后，佩克因涉嫌撰写恐吓信而被捕并被拘留29天。
1934年下半年，佩克从青岛返回上海，并在国际饭店大楼临时工作。后来一段时间，他受雇于位于四川路110号的国际调查社（International Investigation Agency）。1936年，他在爱多亚路117号的多多贸易公司（Dody Trading Company）做了几个月的佣金制推销员。他还曾在福煦路620号、由 V.A. 奇利金（V.A. Chilikin）所有的《俄罗斯日报》（Russian Daily News）短暂担任广告招揽员。
佩克娶了一位 N.D. 基里尔科（N.D. Kirilko）小姐为妻。他们育有两个孩子。1936年2月，他与妻子分居，据报道，其妻目前与一名受雇于霍尔与霍尔茨公司（Hall & Holtz Co.）的英国人同居。1937年4月11日，佩克与该英国人发生争执，导致两人在霞飞路606弄13号发生斗殴。
根据上海公共租界工部局警务处寄宿公寓管理科的记录，佩克自1934年11月1日至1935年1月17日居住在韦斯德路71号，后因未支付15美元房费而潜逃。他最后已知的住址是霞飞路606弄13号（24）

(C.I.D.) Office Notes
January 31, 1929.

Despite careful enquiries no trace of any person
named Benker can be found. There is, however, an
Alexander Becker, who may be the person referred to.
He is described as a Russian Jew of about 30 years of
age, who arrived in Shanghai some 6 years ago. Previous
to coming to Shanghai he resided in Germany and Holland
for a number of years and is able to speak German
fluently.

Becker was formerly employed by Imas of No. 24
Chafoong Road as a baggage porter, and is now working
in a similar capacity for Jack Polenetsky of the Union
Transfer Coy., No. 347 Broadway. He used to reside
with Carl Gunther (who was sentenced to ten months'
imprisonment in April 1928 in connection with an arms
deal) at No. 23 Kungping Terrace and is reported to
have assisted him in small deals in arms, but it is
not believed he would engage in a deal where hundreds
of pistols or rifles are concerned. Becker is the
type of person, however, who would be apt to boast of
having carried through such transactions.

Should any further information be learned
regarding this person a report will be submitted.

W. Ounean.
D. S.

(刑事侦缉处) 办公笔记
1929年1月31日。

尽管经过仔细查询，未找到任何名为本克（Benker）的人的踪迹。然而，有一位亚历山大·贝克尔（Alexander Becker），可能是所指之人。据描述，他是一名约30岁的犹太裔俄国人，大约6年前抵达上海。在来上海之前，他在德国和荷兰居住了数年，并能流利地说德语。

贝克尔以前受雇于乍浦路24号的伊马斯（Imas），担任行李搬运工，现在百老汇路347号联合转运公司（Union Transfer Coy.）的杰克·波洛内茨基（Jack Polenetsky）处从事类似工作。他曾与卡尔·冈瑟（Carl Gunther）（因涉及一起武器交易于1928年4月被判处十个月监禁）同住于公平台23号，据报道曾协助他进行小型武器交易，但相信他不会参与涉及数百支手枪或步枪的交易。然而，贝克尔是那种倾向于吹嘘自己完成了此类交易的人。

若获悉关于此人的进一步信息，将提交报告。

W. 奥尼恩（W. Ounean）。
D. S.
